title: One Project, Many Environments
subtitle: A proposal: environments as overlays on project defaults

chapters.title: The Problem
chapters.blurb: One target URL and one set of instructions per project cannot describe a product that runs in many places, and an override URL carries no logins, instructions, or environment identity.

chapters.title: The Database Solution
chapters.blurb: Project fields become the defaults; environment rows overlay them, overriding or inheriting per field, with one nullable run column and a journey exclusions table — everything additive.

chapters.title: Different Environments, Different Triggers
chapters.blurb: Production runs nightly on weekdays, staging runs when a deploy to main completes, pull requests run when ready for review, and journeys run everywhere unless an exclusion row says otherwise.
